_comment: Optional. Copy to .george/models/presets.json to put your own launch scripts one click away in Models -> Now serving (and /models presets <id>). Blue Lodge ships no presets: use this for custom stacks such as a forked llama.cpp build or a split-GPU layout. 'script' must live under scripts/ in the lodge; args are plain tokens. Labels and descriptions are yours: state the real context size your script configures.

presets.label: My custom stack
presets.description: Launches my own llama-server build with my settings (edit me).
